rating_method.ovr_calibration: active players in nflverse week 7 league roster
rating_method.physical: combine measurements where joined; otherwise position/body regression; simulator body derived by existing sprint model
rating_method.rating_label: estimated public-research rating; not EA/Madden official ratings or measured tracking
rating_method.skills: shrunk position-normalized 2025 + 2026 weeks 1-6 production and draft/experience priors
rating_method.uncertainty: per-attribute evidence confidence and imputed combine input list

CHI.method_note: Roster membership comparison only; it does not classify a move as trade, signing, injury, or release.

NE.method_note: Roster membership comparison only; it does not classify a move as trade, signing, injury, or release.
